new_value: Fixed (commit on beads-worker-3): the test's contract is correct — a failed observer callback must NOT consume the announce sequence number. Root cause: ingest updated peer->seq_num BEFORE notify_observers, so after the callback-failure (-EINVAL) the same-seq retry was judged stale (announce_seq_newer(7,7) false) and the non-reset observer filtered (-EALREADY, calls=1). Fix: capture the pre-ingest (seq, location_seq) and roll back under announce_mutex on notify failure (ingest_mutex held throughout — no observable window). REVIEW hardening from 3 kimi-k3 passes: (a) rollback is now conditional (only if the stream state still equals what this ingest wrote) — a reentrant observer that accepted a newer announce between update and failure would otherwise have its state clobbered, re-opening a replay window (security-relevant edge, pass 3); (b) prev_* typed uint16_t to match the fields; stale path needs no rollback (deferred update untouched — verified). TOFU new-peer rollback restores seq 0 with the pin retained (pre-existing pin-retention policy, no degraded replay protection). Passes 1+2 PASS (lock ordering ingest->announce matches the documented order; signature re-verified on retry; no seq-rollback replay window).
